question: Which of the following statements is NOT true about the two - sector model?

options.text: The government sector plays an important role.
The economy is considered to be closed.
Firms are the only producing sector in the economy.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The government sector plays an important role.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• In a two-sector model, the economy is simplified to include only two sectors: households and firms.

• There is no foreign sector in a two-sector model, so the economy is considered closed.

• The government sector is not included in a two-sector model, hence it does not play any role.

• Firms are considered the only producing sector in the economy, while households provide factors of production.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Two-Sector Model:**

• The two-sector model is a simplified representation of the economy that includes only two sectors: households and firms.

• Households provide factors of production (such as labor, land, and capital) to firms and receive income in return.

• Firms use these factors of production to produce goods and services, which are then sold to households.

• This model assumes that there is no government or foreign sector, making it a closed economy.

• **Closed Economy:**

• A closed economy is one that does not engage in international trade, meaning it does not import or export goods and services.

• All economic activities occur within the domestic borders, and the economy is self-sufficient.

• The two-sector model assumes a closed economy as it does not include a foreign sector.

• **Households and Firms:**

• Households are the owners of factors of production and the consumers of goods and services.

• Firms are the producers of goods and services and the employers of factors of production.

• The interaction between households and firms forms the basis of the two-sector model, highlighting the flow of goods, services, and income between them.
